terms.intro: Welcome to Book My Salon. By using our app you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before booking a salon slot.
terms.usage: You must provide accurate contact details. One account per mobile number. Misuse, fake bookings, or queue manipulation may lead to account suspension.
terms.bookings: Bookings are subject to salon availability. You may cancel up to 30 minutes before your slot. No-shows may affect your queue priority.
terms.liability: Book My Salon connects customers with salons. We are not responsible for service quality at partner salons. For disputes, contact support.

privacy.intro: Book My Salon respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.data: We collect your name, mobile number, optional email, booking history, and location (when you search nearby salons). OTP is used only for verification.
privacy.sharing: We do not sell your data. Booking details are shared with the salon you book. Payment partners receive only transaction data.
privacy.rights: You can update your profile, delete saved addresses, and opt out of marketing notifications in app settings. Contact support to request data deletion.

booking.q: How do I book a salon slot?
booking.a: Open a salon, select services, tap Book Slot, choose date and time, then login and verify OTP to confirm.

cancel.a: Yes. Go to My Bookings, open your booking, and tap Cancel Booking. You can rebook anytime.

payment.a: Pay online at booking confirmation or at the salon. Saved UPI and cards can be managed in Payment Methods.

queue.a: The queue shows your position at the salon. Online bookings are prioritized with a 2 online : 1 walk-in rule.
